title: Audio content
description: The `audio` content block, carrying base64-encoded audio data and its MIME type.
question: Does an audio result survive adaptation?
notes: Pydantic AI keeps audio as audio; the OpenAI Agents SDK re-serializes it into text. Both were re-measured at the adapter helper and at the agent path and answered the same way at each. 3 cannot reach the revision.

notes_by_num.1: CrewAI 1.15.1 requires MCP Python SDK 1.26.x, so it cannot open a 2026-07-28 adapter session.
notes_by_num.2: LangChain MCP Adapters 0.3.2 requires mcp<2.0.0, so it cannot open a 2026-07-28 adapter session.
notes_by_num.3: OpenAI Agents SDK 0.22.0: the audio block is re-serialized as JSON inside a text output item. The base64 payload and `audio/wav` MIME type are all still present, but the agent receives them as characters rather than as audio content.
notes_by_num.4: Mastra 1.17.3 negotiated MCP 2025-11-25. The scanner refused to compare that capture with a 2026-07-28 source.

verdict.headline: Kept by Pydantic AI, flattened into JSON text by the OpenAI Agents SDK.
verdict.detail: Pydantic AI 2.40.0 returns a `BinaryContent` carrying the `audio/wav` media type. OpenAI Agents SDK 0.22.0 preserves the bytes but not the kind, so anything downstream must recognise a JSON blob inside a text item to find the audio. CrewAI, LangChain and Mastra cannot negotiate MCP 2026-07-28, so they reach none of it.

usage_note: Not published. Candidate source: count of public MCP servers using this capability. Not estimated, so the panel stays empty until the corpus is scanned.
why: Audio is the least-implemented content type in the union, which makes it the sharpest test of whether a framework handles the content list generically or only the cases it happened to code for.
